cycles.method: Not measured. An event is one YES (or LEVEL to the left) on the SCENE GEN row: 40 page-descriptor reads, at most 3,840 locks drawn and two copies of the 4,096-byte scene block, on the UI task, never in an interrupt; the crossfader morph then runs once, as a fader move runs it. To measure on a unit: the base's development cost stamps around the row's setter. Budget: one UI tick, 16.4 ms at 61 ticks a second, 4,330,000 cycles at 264 MHz.

load.method: Not measured. The module adds nothing to the frame interrupt and has no MIDI path; its only work is the row action above, outside playback's path.

stress.droppedExplanation: No flood ran: SCENE GEN sends and receives no MIDI. To run: 16 PATH on ALL tracks and ALL pages while a pattern with three LFOs a track plays at 240 BPM, generating and undoing repeatedly for 60 s while the crossfader moves, checking playback, the panel and USB.
